name: Find error workflows that n8n silently skips and alert on Telegram

parameters.content:
## Find error workflows that n8n silently skips

### Who's it for
Anyone running self-hosted n8n who has set an error workflow under a workflow's settings and assumes failures are being reported. On any instance past a handful of workflows, at least one of those routes is usually broken and nothing says so.

### How it works
Once a day it reads your own instance through the n8n API and follows every error workflow reference to the workflow it points at. Three things break that route in silence:

- **The handler has no published version.** n8n skips it, writes one line to the server log, and moves on. No failed execution, nothing in the UI, no notification. Checking whether the handler is active is not the same test and will miss this.
- **The handler was deleted.** The reference stays behind in the producing workflow's settings.
- **The handler has no Error Trigger node**, so n8n has nothing to start it with.

Findings are grouped by handler and sent to Telegram, naming the workflows whose failures would go unreported. Silence from this workflow means every route checked out.

### How to set up
1. Create an n8n API credential with read access to workflows and select it on the Get workflows node.
2. Create a Telegram credential and put your chat ID into the Settings node.
3. Change the schedule if once a day is not what you want.

### Requirements
Self-hosted n8n with the public API enabled, and a Telegram bot.

### How to customize
Set alertWhenClean to true in the Settings node if you would rather get a daily all clear than silence. Replace the Telegram node with Slack, email or a webhook; everything upstream stays the same.

### Schedule and settings
Runs once a day. Put your Telegram chat ID in the Settings node.

### Read the instance, follow every reference
One API call returns every workflow with its settings and its published version. The code follows each error workflow reference and reports the ones n8n cannot call.

### Alert only when something is broken
No message means every route checked out. Set alertWhenClean to true if you would rather hear from it every day.
